2912512.sourceDescription: When you want a bit of festive atmosphere without taking over the whole room, this 3ft Christmas tree is just the thing. It's a traditional style that's easy to set up and ready to decorate however you fancy. The stand comes included, so you're good to go straight out of the box. Made from PVC with flat needles and 121 tips, it's got that classic Christmas tree shape with fixed branches that hold their form. It's fire retardant and designed for indoor use, so you can pop it on a table, in a corner, or anywhere you want a splash of seasonal cheer. Minimal assembly means you'll have it up and looking festive in no time. .
